item.title: Bulletin updated at 01:50 HKT 09/Oct/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Koinu will move across the coastal waters of Guangdong today. Under the influence of Koinu's rainbands and the monsoon, it will be windy with squally showers over the coast of Guangdong. With Koinu departing and weakening and the influence of a dry northeast monsoon, the weather will become fine over southern China in the middle and latter parts of this week. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large. Besides, a broad area of low pressure is expected to bring unsettled weather to the central part of the South China Sea during the weekend and early next week.

Weather: Cloudy with squally showers and thunderstorms. Showers will be heavy at times. Seas will be very rough with swells.
Temp range: 24 - 27 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High
